description.value: Cafe Dorothy is a fresh handmade bakery and dessert café in Coquitlam specializing in coffee drinks, pastries, and desserts. The café operates primarily as a takeout counter with online ordering available for pickup, making it a quick stop for cyclists looking to fuel up. It is located in a unit at 1163 Pinetree Way, likely within a commercial plaza.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business name, address (#1160 - 1163 Pinetree Way, Coquitlam, BC V3B 7L2), and phone (+1 778-951-1518), all consistent with OSM tags. The website repeatedly describes Cafe Dorothy as a takeout-focused bakery/dessert café in Coquitlam — notably, OSM lists the community as 'North Vancouver' but the website unambiguously places the business in Coquitlam (postal code V3B 7L2 also confirms Coquitlam). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, wi-fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Coquitlam — confirmed by website text ('Fresh Handmade Bakery & Dessert Cafe in Coquitlam'), full address, and postal code V3B 7L2. The OSM community tag should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café with an active website and online ordering — a legitimate food and drink stop for touring cyclists in Coquitlam.

wow_evidence: takeout counter with online ordering available for pickup
